summary: Assemble a small complete language-model experiment whose correctness and limitations can be inspected.
outcomes: Train and resume a tiny model from a documented corpus
Compare held-out loss, generations and a simple baseline
sequence: Freeze a tiny corpus and evaluation split
Verify tokenizer and model tensor shapes
Inspect generations and publish an experiment report

visual.question: Which artifact is needed to reproduce or resume each stage?

practice.task: Train a CPU-sized language model with a reproducible report
practice.success: A fresh run can load the checkpoint and reproduce declared evaluation within tolerances
